name: Squid Game 3 Troll Tower
desc:
Welcome to Squid Game 3 Troll Tower!
Think you can survive the madness and reach the top?
Troll your friends, dodge pushes, and avoid falling traps!
Only the most clever (or lucky) players will make it to the top of the Troll Tower.
Inspired by games like Slap Tower and Rope Troll Tower Squid Game

Will you get pushed off… or push your way to victory?
